item.description:
This is the first custom Monopoly game for Romania and has points of interest in Bucharest.
Berăria H, also known as The Lively City, is the place where you come to enjoy quality music, to see your beloved artists, both national and international, in spectacular shows. You also come for the delicious dishes and various types of Beer and alcohol.
The concept is unique, fun and educational at the same time, and salt and pepper are the Sansa and the Cafar of the Community. In other words, it's the place where you come when you want to be sure you will have a memorable evening!

A monopoly (from Greek monos μόνος (alone or single) + polein πωλεῖν (to sell)) exists when a specific person or enterprise is the only supplier of a particular commodity.
Monopoly is a roll-and-move game where players move around the game board buying or trading properties, developing their properties with houses and hotels. When opponents land on players owned property, the owning player collects rent from the landing player. Owning sets of properties increases the rent paid to the player who owns them, by the player who lands on the square. The ultimate goal is to have the most money and drive opponents into bankruptcy.
The classic Monopoly with constructions and other elements of the city of Besançon, in France.

item.description:
Go on a journey of discovery with the MONOPOLY Biel / Bienne
Biel / Bienne is the largest bilingual city in Switzerland and the second largest city in the canton of Bern.
Biel is the regional and economic center for both the Seeland and the Bernese Jura and parts of the canton of Solothurn. It also has several universities of applied sciences. Bienne is the most important center of the Swiss watch industry, ahead of Le Locle, Grenchen and La Chaux-de-Fonds.
All spaces are in French and German and the game is supplied with two packs of cards, one for each language.

item.description:
To mark the fifteenth anniversary of Unesco, the City of Binche had the idea to publish a Monopoly to his colours. 1,500 copies of this version was made and was a great success.
We know Binchou's love for their City of the Gille so everything has been thought of in this special version to flatter the nice Chauvinism binchois. Players can buy emblematic places in their city, starting from the newly renovated Chapelle de Bettignies to the Hôtel de Ville, the most expensive acquisition.
Even the banknotes are in the colours of the folklore, taking again the characters of the carnival. Attention to detail, the famous chance cards and community box do not escape the binchoise sauce. Depending on the pickaxe, your fat Sunday costume will be offered, you will receive money to buy mimosa or a new Gille mask.
Pour marquer le quinzième anniversaire de l'Unesco, la Ville de Binche a eu l'idée de publier un Monopoly à ses couleurs. 1 500 exemplaires de cette version ont été réalisés et ont été un grand succès.
On connaît l'amour des Binchoux pour leur cité du gille, alors tout a été pensé dans cette version spéciale pour flatter le sympathique chauvinisme binchois. Les joueurs peuvent acheter des lieux emblématiques de leur ville, de la Chapelle de Bettignies récemment rénovée à l'Hôtel de Ville, l'acquisition la plus chère.
Même les billets sont aux couleurs du folklore, reprenant les personnages du carnaval. Souci du détail, les fameuses cartes chance et boite communautaire n'échappent pas à la sauce binchoise. Selon la pioche, votre gros costume du dimanche vous sera offert, vous recevrez de l'argent pour acheter du mimosa ou un nouveau masque de gille.

From the Warrior Falls Challenge Pool, to the Hall of Kings, to the Tribal Council Room in the Golden City, this Edition of the Monopoly game features locations and themes inspired by Marvel's Black Panther.
